normally do in this game.

Some of what a vehicle carries, or has carried, is drawn or hidden wrongly compared with that
vehicle (it can show through something that covers the vehicle, instead of being hidden with
it, and its effects can be off too), some shadows
don't fall or turn like the others in the clip, and the race view sometimes shows more of the
road behind the vehicle it follows than ahead of it. Which things, when, and what they should
look like instead can be seen in the recording: the same kind of thing is drawn correctly
elsewhere in the same clip.

Please fix all problems. Apart from these, the track layout and the vehicles' movement in
the recording are correct and should keep looking the way they do now.

## Attached visual evidence

The recording is at `/app/.harbor_assets/recording.mp4`.

Inspect the attached video before making changes. You can pull individual frames out of it with
`ffmpeg`.

I fixed all the problems I found in the recording. The project compiles and the `core-tests` suite passes. I couldn't run the game here to re-record, so none of these fixes has been checked on screen.

**Carried items (missile, mine)**
- **Missile shows through the bridge** (around 8–9 s): while the car carries it, the missile and its reactor flame were always drawn at the top layer. When the car went under the bridge, the car disappeared but the missile and its shadow stayed visible on top. A carried missile is now drawn at its car's layer (normal or airborne) and takes the car's colour effects, such as the darkening when it sinks into water. Its shadow is drawn on the ground and hidden while the car is falling (`bonus/Missile.java`).
- **Missile points the wrong way**: it was given the car's angle in degrees, which the physics treated as radians. That's why the carried missile sat across the car at an odd angle, and why the fired missile (around 9.8 s) flew off down and away from the car's heading. It now uses the car's actual angle.
- **Reactor flame misplaced**: the flame was attached to the missile's side instead of its tail; it is now at the tail.
- **Carried mine**: the same kind of bug. It is now drawn at its owner's layer when the owner is airborne, and its shadow is hidden while the owner is falling (`bonus/Mine.java`).
- **Car's turbo flame**: it now gets the same water darkening as the car when the car falls in (`racer/VehicleRenderer.java`).

**Shadows**
- **Shadows don't turn**: in `utils/BodyRegionDrawer.java`, shadows of crates, bonus boxes and the missile were rotated by a radian value where degrees were expected, so they didn't follow their object's rotation. They also ignored the object's scale. Both are fixed.
- **Car shadow on the wrong side**: the car's shadow fell up and to the left while every other shadow falls down and to the right. It now matches the others (`racer/VehicleRenderer.java`).

**Camera** (`racescreen/RacerCameraUpdater.java`)
- **Showing more road behind than ahead**: the look-ahead offset was mirrored on the horizontal axis. On the long straight where the car drives left, the camera sat behind the car. It now looks ahead in the direction the car is facing.
- **Speed limit had no effect**: the cap on how fast the camera can move was applied after the new position was already set. It now takes effect.

Nothing in the track layout or the car's movement code was touched.
